tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is Deep Navy from the brand palette; light is a cool off-white so white cards still read as raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebars, chart tracks, the unfilled part of a ring, wells inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart panels, menus.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, nav items and secondary buttons. One step up from the surface it sits on.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, chart gridlines. Decorative, so not held to a contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, secondary buttons, the unchecked toggle track. Steel Gray on navy (5.5:1); a step darker on light grounds so it holds 3.1:1 on surface as well as on white.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The toggle knob and the ring's end cap. White on either track, as the brand sheet draws it; the toggle's state is carried by knob position and track colour (accent or line-strong), not by the knob.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 15.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy: card subtitles, descriptions, table cells. On any surface: 9.6:1 dark, 8.2:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, axis ticks, timestamps, placeholder text. On any surface: 5.0:1 dark, 5.2:1 light. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only, intentionally below the text floor; pair with a disabled cursor, never with information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ambient Yellow as a fill: the primary button, the live dot, the checked toggle, the first chart series in the dark theme. Never as text on a light ground (1.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed accent fills, a touch deeper so the change reads without a lift.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label). Black, 16.8:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text or a meaningful icon: links, the active nav glyph, a highlighted value. 12.7:1 on surface (dark); darkened to 6.6:1 on white (light).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-ink: the active sidebar item, an accent badge, a highlighted table row.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The ink of the supplied mark file. Use it for the logo only; UI accents use accent. Reconcile with the brand team: the palette sheet names #ffe600, the mark is drawn in this gold.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: A good change (spend down, uptime up): delta text and the up arrow beside it. 8.3:1 on surface-raised (dark), 5.5:1 on white (light). Always beside a sign or arrow; a mint green, so it leaves the red-green axis.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind positive text (the delta pill).

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: A bad change, an error, a breached budget: delta text, input error borders, destructive buttons. 5.9:1 on surface-raised (dark), 6.3:1 on white (light). Always beside a sign, arrow or word.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind negative text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The first series: the story of the chart. Ambient Yellow on navy; Deep Navy on white, because yellow cannot carry a 2px line on a light ground. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: The second series, usually a comparison (last period, forecast, another provider). Steel; 5.2:1 dark, 4.7:1 light. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: A third series when two are not enough. Past three, split into small multiples. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the baseline: the hairline token, solid, never dashed.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: The unfilled remainder of a ring or meter.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter at 600, tracked tighter as it grows. One display line per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline on marketing pages. Two lines at most.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles and the mission statement.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body text is 15px in the product and 17px on marketing pages. Weight carries hierarchy; size rarely does.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Emphasised lines inside body text, list titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Ambiently collects telemetry data to help the world understand what's happening, in real time.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Live telemetry from around the world.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels, nav items, legends, tooltip text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units, timestamps, axis ticks, helper text. The smallest size for anything that must be read.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and the tagline. Set text in capitals yourself; the style does not transform case.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Numbers are the product. Big ones use proportional figures; columns use tabular figures.

styles.name: stat-large
styles.usage: The one hero figure a dashboard leads with.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile values and ring centres.

styles.name: tabular
styles.usage: Numbers in table columns and axis ticks; add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits align.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Identifiers, SDK snippets, model names in tables.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Controls sit on 8s, cards on 16s and 24s, sections on 32+. Generous by default: when in doubt, take the next step up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, the gap between a delta arrow and its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, nav item padding, the gutter between stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on compact screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gutter of the dashboard grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a card title and its chart; page side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding; above and below a mission statement.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

radius.note: Continuous, generous corners. Controls are pills; containers are 16px; the radius grows with the box.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tooltip, swatches, the bar-chart data end (as 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, icon buttons, nav items, legend keys.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, the app icon tile, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, toggles, the live dot.

shadow.note: Dark surfaces separate with hairlines and tone, not shadows. Light surfaces get one soft lift.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest in the light theme; none in the dark theme, where line does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, anything floating above the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px solid accent (dark) or Deep Navy (light). A box-shadow, so it follows the control's radius.

size.note: Control heights and the icon grid.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, selects in a card header, toolbar icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing buttons.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside text, badges and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, nav items and card headers.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, the iconography sheet.
